requirements.statement: Employees can submit an expense claim with amount, date, category, and description

criteria.must: An employee can submit a claim providing amount, date, category and description
A newly submitted claim starts in pending status

requirements.statement: Employees can view the status of their own submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee sees a list of their own claims
Each listed claim shows its current status (pending, approved, or rejected)
An employee cannot see another employee's claims

requirements.statement: Employees can edit or withdraw a claim while it is still pending

criteria.must: An employee can edit a pending claim's details
An employee can withdraw a pending claim
An employee cannot edit or withdraw a claim that is already approved or rejected

requirements.statement: Managers can see a list of claims pending their approval

criteria.must: A manager sees a list of pending claims submitted by their employees
A manager does not see pending claims submitted by employees who do not report to them

requirements.statement: Managers can approve a submitted claim

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim from their team
An approved claim becomes eligible for payroll export

requirements.statement: Managers can reject a submitted claim with a reason

criteria.must: A manager can reject a pending claim from their team while providing a reason
The employee can see the rejection reason on their rejected claim

requirements.statement: Finance can view all approved claims

criteria.must: Finance sees a list of every approved claim across all employees

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved claims to a file payroll can import

criteria.must: Finance can trigger an export that produces a downloadable CSV file of approved claims
The exported CSV file requires no manual re-entry of claim data by payroll

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked as exported so the same claim is never exported twice

criteria.must: A claim included in an export is marked as exported
An already-exported claim is excluded from a subsequent export
